senses.gloss: (√מד; v. מָדַד) to form an approximate estimate, to guess; to appraise, judge, deliver an expert’s opinion.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 58b:8">Erub. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>אוֹמְדוֹ וכ׳</he> he forms an approximate estimate of the height of the hill, and passes on.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 78b:12">Snh. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>אֲמָדוּהוּ למיתה</he> they (the experts) declared his injuries to be fatal; (Y. ib. IX, 27ᵃ bot., also <he>עמד׳</he>) <he>א׳ לחיים</he> the opinion was that he would recover; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 51a:7">Ḥull. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>אמדה נפשה</he> the animal before taking a leap measures its strength.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64:6">Gen. R. s. 64</cite> <he>שהאמידו אותה</he> they had appraised it (the field,—as to how much it would yield). V. <cite ref="A00689"><he>אוּמָד</he></cite>
